The '''Sif-Uwana Council''' was an organization based on [[Sif-Uwana]]. One of [[Talon Karrde]]'s aliases, which he used while visiting [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]], was "[[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] Pandis Hart", supposedly the council's chief purchasing agent.
